apps.notes: 2026-04-06 Apps Convergence (25→20): ChatGPT-style app directory consolidated by use case after SME code audit. 4 categories: Strategy & Research (3), Submission Authoring (5), Intelligence & Analysis (4), Quality & Lifecycle (8). Two new merged hubs use chat-first priming: 'device-strategy' (merges device-pathway + q-submission + predicate-finder) and 'device-engineering' (merges risk-management + samd-cybersecurity + human-factors + biocompatibility). All 17 backend-rich apps preserved (real services, tool panels, workspace views, embedded modules). 9 legacy IDs preserved as fallthrough cases for back-compat with stored nav targets, saved actions, and project app connections. Server KNOWN_APP_IDS, useProjectApps catalog, and @-mention list synced.
